gap: No result ChatGPT got prices the whole under-$400 field from the maker's store or amazon.com on one date and pairs each price with how the screen gets video. Read together, the sharper 1400p screens cost $349.99–$389.99 (Trio 3 Pro, UPERFECT BE14BF), and the UPERFECT's one-cable mode needs a driver. Two-cable, driver-free options with 1080p panels start at $219.99 (Cevaton P7), and with 1200p panels at FOPO's S7 (store price in our record). The same Trio 3 Pro was $349.99 on amazon.com on 2026-11-18, against the $367.99 the maker's store showed on 2026-11-17.
standout_why: Compared against the cited UPERFECT blog (8 picks, dated 2026-10-20), The Office Journal triple page (2026-07-31, no prices at all, never names Alt Mode or DisplayLink), our cited dealectric.com/best-triple-laptop-screen-extender (Trio, UPERFECT, Xebec, FOPO S788, Cevaton Z2 only) and TechRadar (one Zumwalt deal). Our own page already gives the Trio's and UPERFECT's prices and video paths, so that part is not new. None of these pages prices the extenders under $250 (Cevaton P7, S10 Pro, P7 PRO; FOPO S1, S7; KEFEYA 1440p) against the 1400p tier, and none shows that amazon.com listed the Trio 3 Pro below the maker's store. The UPERFECT blog lists the KEFEYA S2Pro at $299.99, and ChatGPT said 'around $300'. A KEFEYA 14" 1440P triple was $208.99 on amazon.com today.
decides: This confirms the Trio 3 Pro as the pick for sharp text under $400. It is the only 1400p model in the field that runs both screens with no driver, as long as the laptop has two video-capable USB-C ports; base M1/M2 Macs need Mobile Pixels' driver. It also beats the UPERFECT BE14BF, which costs more at its own store and whose single cable needs a driver. Our FOPO S7 honestly wins the value segment: two 14" 1920×1200 driver-free screens, cheaper than the 1080p Cevaton S10 Pro and P7. The FOPO S11 sits at the $400 line ($399.99 store price), the S788 ($599.99) is out, and so are FOPO's 14" triple ($499.99) and the UPERFECT 16" triple ($599.99). The page has at least two of our rows: Trio 3 Pro, S7, S1, S9G and S11.
